This bot retests PRs for certain kubernetes repos according to the following rules:
- The PR does have any `do-not-merge/*` labels
- The PR does not have the `needs-ok-to-test` label
- The PR is mergeable (does not have a `needs-rebase` label)
- The PR is approved (has `cncf-cla: yes`, `lgtm`, `approved` labels)
- The PR is failing tests required for merge

- Review the [full test history](https://prow.k8s.io/pr-history/?org=kubernetes&repo=kubernetes&pr=123857) for this PR
- Prevent this bot from retesting with `/lgtm cancel` or `/hold`
- Help make our tests less flaky by following our [Flaky Tests Guide][1]

review_comments: is the failure policy change needed / relevant?
It is for testing the update value of FailurePolicy. We set the failurePolicy to Ignore when patching and set it to Fail while testing update.
do we need to exercise delete / deletecollection?
filter out items with non-nil deletionTimestamp + finalizers before asserting length
filter the list to items with no finalizers before asserting length
do we need to add something to this rule so it doesn't disrupt unrelated deployments (some namespace selector of object selector), or is this inert because we're not creating a binding?

This test is only for testing the API operations of validatingadmissionpolicy so it just tries to create a validatingadmissionpolicy without getting it in use(no binding). So I guess it should be ok to skip rules :)
this is a non-existent policy, right?
Yes. It is a fake policy since the tests only focus on API operations.
